name: Poison Fizz (Lesser)
text:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
Made from a special mixture of honey and alchemical reagents, poison fizz is a zesty, sweet rock candy that pops and crackles in your mouth. For 1 hour, you have a +2 item bonus to saving throws against poison and being petrified.

Secondary Effect 2 (poison)

Effect You bite the poison fizz to release its poisonous liquid center and spray green mist in a 15-foot cone. This deals 3d6 poison with a DC 24 basic Reflex save. A creature that critically fails is also Blinded until the end of your next turn and is then temporarily immune to being blinded by poison fizz for 1 hour.

Effect: Poison Fizz
